notes.title: Update to Hana's Picks!
notes.content:
In the previous update Hana can decide one of the most difficult choices for you:
'Which hero/champion should I play this time?'

In addition to new released characters which can be accessed by

pick lol
pick dota
pick smite
pick overwatch

Hana can also decide with

pick paladins

Can you get a winning streak with Hana's Picks?


(Check out "csgo" in the talk-mode.) :hanawoo:
